description: This PHP script handles exporting account and contact data from a SugarCRM-based system, including generating CSV files for email and full data exports, with filtering and field selection features.

methods.name: br2nl_int
methods.description: Converts Windows-style line breaks to spaces in a string.

methods.name: getStdContactFlds
methods.description: Retrieves standard contact fields from the database and appends them to the queryFields array.

methods.name: getExpWhereClause
methods.description: Builds a SQL WHERE clause based on user input fields and types for filtering export data.
